source: Cambodia Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF), presentation deck "ប្រព័ន្ធវប្បកម្មដំណាំស្រូវ តាមគោលការណ៍ធម្មជាតិ (ប.វ.ស)" [System of Rice Intensification Following Natural Principles (SRI)], undated PowerPoint presentation (no author, date, or elibrary URL visible on slides)
text:
Seed selection criteria for the System of Rice Intensification (SRI): choose pure, quality seed with a germination rate of 85% or higher; choose a variety known to give high yield; choose a variety with a short growth duration (early- or medium-duration rice); choose a variety with resistance to drought, insect pests, and disease; and consider grain quality and eating taste.

Seedbed site selection: choose soil that drains and takes in water easily; choose a location that is easy to protect from livestock and birds; the seedbed soil should have good inherent fertility; and the site should be located away from sources of pollution or waste.

Seedbed sizing and preparation: for 1 hectare of field to be transplanted, a seedbed (nursery) area of about 150-200 square meters is needed. Apply natural/organic fertilizer to the seedbed at a rate of about 3-5 kg per square meter, harrow the soil finely, then raise the soil into small beds 1.5-2 meters wide. Beds of this width make it easy to sow, to water or drain, to weed, and to control insect pests in the nursery.
